children: Aug 31 (Reuters) – Details of the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas' Texas monthly manufacturing index released on Monday. Following are details from the survey.Only some items are seasonally adjusted:

August        July                                              Index       IndexProduction                                     16.1        10.1Capacity Utilization                           12.8         5.9New Orders                                     22.0         6.4Growth Rate of Orders                           8.1        -0.4Unfilled Orders                                -1.3        -2.0Shipments                                      14.1         8.8Delivery Time                                  12.5         2.3Finished Goods Inventories                      2.9         1.5Prices Paid for Raw Materials                  44.1        41.3Prices Received for Finished Goods             22.7        25.6Wages and Benefits                             21.1        30.8Employment                                      8.0        12.2Hours Worked                                    5.9         4.3Capital Expenditures                            8.2        12.2General Business ConditionsCompany Outlook                                19.2        13.4General Business Activity                      11.6         1.3
NOTES: The index measures Texas' factory activity. Readings above zero indicate expansion and negative levels contraction. ((U.S. Treasury desk; Tel: + 1 202 898 8310))
